demos.name: PingOne Events Lab
demos.description: See what PingOne delivers through a webhook subscription: an events page, delivery health (including a site that answers 200 with a web page and silently discards events) and optional forwarding to Elasticsearch for Kibana. Mock needs nothing. Also runs on SE K8 so PingOne can reach it.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7803). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials. Docker: HOST_PORT=7803 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Real: PINGONE_* for the read-only pull, ELASTICSEARCH_* to forward; both owner-run and UNVERIFIED against live systems. Run locally it cannot receive PingOne deliveries; the SE deployment (k8s/) does. Catalog id D124 is provisional until the owner confirms.
